title: Storm Fang

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Storm Fang is the modified form of Ash Fang using Iolite. Like all modified-weapons that use Iolite, they gain 10 lightning damage, however, the bow is unique in that its hit effect has a 20% chance to apply Chain lightning.
An upgraded Ash Fang will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones.

Storm Fang

Internal ID: BowAshlandsStorm | Type: Bow | Source: Black forge | Usage: Ranged weapon | Wielding: Two-handed | Crafting Materials: Flametal x15, Iolite x3 | Attack speed: 0.8 s + 2.5 s draw time | Movement speed: -5%

Introduction. Storm Fang is the modified form of Ash Fang using Iolite. Like all modified-weapons that use Iolite, they gain 10 lightning damage, however, the bow is unique in that its hit effect has a 20% chance to apply Chain lightning.
An upgraded Ash Fang will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones.
